messages:
oliver: quick update — I ran a kernel sweep across regions (us-west, us-east, eu-west) for tiny-llama2-7b @ seq=2048. Tested: FlashAttn v2 (vendor), FlashAttn v3 (triton), Triton native kernels, and vendor attention lib. attaching short summary + sample numbers.

bench-bot: job 1245 finished — artifacts: s3://redwood-ci/bench/1245/* (csv + flamegraphs).

oliver: paste of the trimmed CSV (head):
```
kernel,device,region,batch,throughput_tok/s,p50_ms,p95_ms
flashv3-triton,H100,us-west,1,42000,28,94
flashv2-vendor,H100,us-west,1,38000,32,110
triton-native,H100,us-west,1,35000,35,140
vendor-attn,A100,eu-west,1,30000,40,160
flashv3-triton,A100,eu-west,1,31000,38,150
```

maya: interesting — p95 gap on H100 between flashv3 and triton-native is large at seq=2048. For our latency SLO (p95 < 120ms) flashv3 passes on H100 but triton-native doesn't.

sam: my read: heuristics we should use for automatic kernel routing: 
- prefer flashv3 (triton) on H100 for seq >= 1024 and batch <= 4
- fall back to flashv2 vendor on H100 when q8 quantization is enabled and we see quality regressions
- prefer vendor-attn on A100 for batch sizes >= 8 (throughput wins)
These are heuristics, not final.

aisha: callout — we ran q8 quant on the same model and saw 3% drop on eval rouge/bertscore on our safety prompt set. That correlated with vendor-attn on A100 + q8. So switching kernel+quant combo causes quality regressions. We should add a regression gate.

oliver: agreed. proposal for rollout: canary 3% traffic -> kernel routing policy: region+device+seq -> choose kernel. If eval metrics degrade > 1.5% on canary, automatic rollback. Also expose override flag per-deployment.

sam: config toggle snippet for runtime (example):
```json
{
  "kernel_routing": {
    "rules": [
      {"match": {"device":"H100","seq_min":1024}, "kernel":"flashv3-triton"},
      {"match": {"device":"A100","batch_min":8}, "kernel":"vendor-attn"}
    ],
    "canary_pct": 3
  }
}
```

maya: also note region/cold-cache effects — p50 in eu-west jumped ~10-15ms vs us-west for flashv3 likely due to docker image pulls / NVLINK topo differences. Add warmup and pinned images to reduce variance.

aisha: +1. And add eval harness that runs generation+scoring after kernel flip. No kernel-only benchmark should be the final arbiter.

oliver: next steps: I'll open a PR with the routing rules + canary pipeline and attach the full csv/plots. @sam please add the rollback webhook in the runtime.

sam: on it. ETA EOD. :thumbsup:

bench-bot: benchmark summary link: https://grafana.redwood/boards/bench-1245 (contains latency/throughput charts + per-region panels)

maya: small follow-up — can we add a metric for "quality delta per kernel" to Console so product sees tradeoffs?

oliver: yes — I'll include that in the PR (per-kernel eval delta).

(emoji reactions: oliver :rocket:, aisha :white_check_mark:, sam :eyes:)
